SEPARATE PROPOSED REPAIR AND GAP CERTIFICATE
Status: internally proved at the exact finite-wire sampler interface with explicit parser/symmetric-prefix premises. Conditional repetition consequence depends on L02. No full compression theorem claimed.

C. REPAIR AND PROOF OF THE DETYPING INTERFACE
Keep exactly the Definition5.8 sampler. Define the repaired Boolean predicate
  V_R(x,y,a,b)=1[a=b],                         if x=y;
  V_R(x,y,a,b)=V(original parsed pair,a,b),    if x!=y and pair is nontrivial;
  V_R(x,y,a,b)=1,                             otherwise.
For unsupported malformed questions use the same full-diagonal rule and arbitrary off-diagonal rejection. The full diagonal takes precedence, retaining strict synchrony on the entire formal alphabet. On a nontrivial diagonal, the original predicate is already equality by the original synchronous premise, so this precedence alters no tested original constraint.

Serialization premise for this general repair: all bit/register sizes and padded vertex encodings must be fixed so that a local canonical active view is recognizable and a sampled pair has both active views iff its seed is nontrivial. This is the parser equivalence claimed around source Equation27 and follows from the exact local prefix conditions below. The p=1,t=2 source counterexample has no padding ambiguity. The repair does not silently repair other parameter/serialization inconsistencies.

Local recognition: a question has an active original view iff its prefix is view(v)=(bin(v),neigh(v),0,0,neigh(v),e_v), together with an old payload in L_v's range. On actual sampled questions, both players have active views iff the seed is nontrivial. To prove the difficult direction, Alice active implies s1=s4=neigh(v) and s5_v=1; Bob active implies s3=s5=neigh(u) and s4_u=1. Since the type graph is undirected these cross bits force (u,v)∈E, and all nontrivial conditions hold. The old payloads then come from the same old seed. A trivial pair therefore has at least one inactive side.

Take any supplied perfect globally synchronous oracularizable original strategy. On an active view use its original measurement; on every inactive view output the same fixed existing answer a0 (POVM effects I or0). On nontrivial pairs it is the original perfect strategy. CROSS-AUDIT AFTER INDEPENDENT FREEZE — 2026-10-08

Inputs: my FROZEN_DERIVATION.txt and enumeration; subsequently root-authorized
read of repetition_application/REPORT.txt. That worker confirmed the exact-value
strengthening and is reconciling its report. No new peer argument was included
in my freeze, and no descendants were used.

SEED CONVENTION AND VALUE LOSS
Both derivations use p=m=k=1, the complete two-type graph WITH both loops,
neighbor vectors11, and zero body maps. Both enumerate1024 effective prefixes;
the unused data bit doubles full seeds to2048 without changing masses.
Canonical q0,q1 and malformed zero z agree bit for bit. The ordered witness
masses1/1024,2/1024,2/1024,16/1024 agree exactly. Different displayed witness
prefixes in the two reports merely use different irrelevant mask coordinates;
they produce the same wires. My strict general loss>=1/4096 was independently
frozen. The peer's CHSH loss>=(2-sqrt(2))/1024 is valid and stronger: its four
inner products have the right signs and its vector proof applies directly to
binary contractions, including general commuting POVMs.

The intended Bob symmetry follows naturally from CL recursion indexing by
previous output; nevertheless the source's terse substitution/serialization
conventions are disclosed. The p=1,t=2 fixture has no padding ambiguity.

REPAIR: EXACT AFFINE VALUE WITH EXPLICIT PREMISES
The repair accepts trivial off-diagonal pairs and keeps equality on the FULL
question diagonal. On nontrivial pairs it uses the original synchronous
predicate, so full-diagonal precedence does not change any original score.

Required abstract premises:
  phi is an injective original-question embedding;
  both sampled wires belong to phi's canonical image iff seed is nontrivial;
  conditional nontrivial decoded pair law is exactly mu_original.
Under these, any original strategy extends: original measurements on canonical
wires, scalar fixed-answer measurements elsewhere. A trivial diagonal is never
canonical, since both identical endpoints would then be canonical. Thus every
trivial event succeeds with probability one even for an arbitrary suboptimal or
nonsynchronous ORIGINAL strategy. The target's nontrivial score is precisely its
original score. Conversely restriction of a target strategy is legal and the
trivial score is at most one. Therefore
  omega^t(G_R)=1-rho+rho omega^t(G), t=*,co,
